Calendar & counting notes

How your numbers are calculated +

The term runs August 18-December 16, 2026. Regular classes end December 8. Class counts include your stated weekly meeting times, university holidays, schedule substitutions, and the MIS 445 syllabus cancellation on September 16. Exams are listed separately and are not counted as regular classes. ACCT 212 has in-class exams even though you study its regular material at home; September 22 and October 29 are two additional exam-only dates outside the regular-class count.

September 8 uses Monday’s schedule; November 24 uses Friday’s. No classes on September 7, 11, or 21, October 10-18, or November 25-29. Academic Assessment Days (September 23-27) are not labeled as days off in the academic calendar, so normal meetings remain included.

“Class days left” counts dates with at least one session that has not ended, including today if relevant. “Sessions left” includes in-progress sessions. “Class hours left” counts the remaining duration of those sessions. The departure countdown is pinned to December 17 at 11:00 AM in America/New_York, including the November daylight-saving change.

The MIS 445 exam on October 23 is tentative. ACCT 212 midterm times depend on your section. Final exams are scheduled from your supplied university screenshots: MIS 445 section 01 on December 11, 12:50-3:20 PM in LH 009, and ACCT 212 section 01 on December 14, 8:05-10:05 PM in AA G008. ACCT 212 section 01 matches your syllabus; section 02 shares this slot, while section 03 has a different final. ACCT 212 is included as home study and adds no attendance days or class hours. This is a calendar-based plan, not an attendance record; later instructor changes are not automatically synced.

Final exam dates and rooms were added from your supplied Binghamton schedule screenshots.
